They didn't want answers. They wanted to break him. Publicly. On camera. Like a warning shot to the rest of us. But here's the thing they didn't count on: Kash wouldn't flinch. Not once. Just take a look at this photo, Peter: Kash is cool, calm, and collected because he is right! He didn't apologize. He didn't grovel. He stood tall, like a man with nothing to hide and everything to protect: the law, the truth, and the safety of Americans they've left behind. You see, when we saw Kash standing firm under fire, we thought of you. Peter, we remembered how you've always stood up for what's right, even when it's hard. You've backed the good ones before. You've answered the call when others stayed silent. And if there's anyone who won't let this get buried or forgotten... # [The Most Terrifying Conversation I Ever Had With Voters](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/09/20/the-most-terrifying-conversation-i-ever-had-with-voters/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on September 20, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 09.20.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=40458aacd9bae14623884a31049536a1f3d36fbec452469f77107ba4e7810e85&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9040&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=d4540d9dd71bf26917f8c737ac9e4ce1&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=e10eff99482e57731f2521eb7bf738f7)**
---
| **The Most Terrifying Conversation I’ve Ever Had With Voters**
---
| |
---
The most terrifying conversation I’ve ever had with voters took place in a charming small town in our beautiful 13th Congressional District with...two seemingly-sweet, older ladies.
---
As they approached my tent, I held out my card per usual saying, “Hi, I’m Beth Farnham, running for US Congress. Please vote for me on November 3rd.”
---
They paused and took my literature, murmured a little to each other and looked at me.
---
So I asked, “What is on your heart and mind at the federal level of government?”
---
They responded, “Nothing, really.”
---
I got specific. “How are you doing with the price of gas these days?”
---
Ladies: Fine
---
Me: Really? It’s kind of high right now. That can be hard on people, especially those with fixed incomes.
---
Ladies: That’s okay. We’re willing to pay it.
---
Me: But it would be less if we pulled out of Iran.
---
Ladies: But if we pulled out of Iran, Trump would look weak.
---
Me: Well, he shouldn’t have begun it in the first place.
---
Ladies: It’s okay he’ll finish it.
---
Me: Finish it?
---
Ladies: Yes, he’ll annihilate them.
---
And then I remembered Trump’s Easter promise that “a whole civilization will die tonight” which is Trump’s codespeak for using a nuclear bomb against them.
---
These senior citizens, with all of their lived experience, most likely matriarchs in their own families, were absolutely fine blowing up millions of families across the seas because right-wing media had made them feel that that those other people were a threat.
---
It didn’t matter that Trump had claimed he had ended Iran’s nuclear ability in 2025. It didn’t matter that many Iranians are innocent and at the mercy of their terrible and violent government.
---
As far as these people were concerned, millions of Iranians – children, mothers, fathers, friends, neighbors, coworkers, caregivers, grocers, doctors, lawyers, and all members of their society deserve to die violent, torturous deaths or suffer severe burns, radiation sickness, malnutrition, and illness.
---
Nothing I said could sway them to see the humanity of Iranian people. They approved of a cruel and chaotic narcissist pressing the button of the football that is always near for him to use against a country that did not attack us.
---
The bloodlust of these fellow constituents was just under their thinner skin.
---
For weeks, I kept turning the conversation over and over in my mind. They spoke about nuking human beings as if it was as normal as switching the laundry from the washing machine to the dryer. Worse, they weren’t the only ones. Recently, I encountered some other voters who started to go down that path, so I called them out on it.
---
“Do you think nuking millions of people is doing the Lord’s work? DO YOU?”
---
They backed down and switched tactics, suggesting that Mossad, the Israeli CIA, could simply take out the head of Iranian government. I think if Mossad had that capability, they would have exercised it already. As least these voters began to think beyond deploying a nuclear bomb. Uh, thanks, whoever gave them that fresh idea. It is a bit surreal to be deep in Appalachia, at a county fair no less, squeezed between booths of 3d printed toys and maple candy and casually listen to a fairgoer discuss the assasination strategy of an intelligence agency of a faraway foreign country, by the way.
---
But I don’t know if everyone who was onboard with Trump at Easter has backed down from it.
---
So I try and I work and I talk and I offer everything I can to help my fellow Americans recognize that people different from us who aren’t attacking us don’t deserve such contempt and hatred from their hearts, but to see the humanity in one another.
---
If they can stop hating other people, then maybe, just maybe, they will **#ChooseDemocracy**.
---

---
While our US Representative was silently approving Trump’s trampling of the First Amendment, I was out in our beautiful 13th Congressional District speaking to voters about choosing Democracy on Saturday.
---
Many thanks to the Shippensburg Area Chamber of Commerce for hosting the Shippensburg Beer and Wine Festival today. It was a lovely afternoon of good cheer and good conversation. Even if fairgoers didn’t engage, they chuckled when I asked, “Mixing alcohol with politics? What could possibly go wrong?”
---
But seriously, our precious Democracy is under such threat, the circumstances are so dire, that it is important to try to reach voters wherever you are, even if it’s just a casual afternoon with a cover of John Denver’s music in the background.
---
Many thanks to Campaign Manager Jack Stansbury and Team Members Brian, Claire, Angie, and Chris for setting up, tearing down, and staffing the tent.
---
Together, with voters who love our country as much as we do, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=3f9c917a0b08b6e680a4c553faea02ddf764a7ac1d544576baedf3047c9d8fbd&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9040&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=b48f9026969a21583b5ee352846f8be7&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=e10eff99482e57731f2521eb7bf738f7) !

| **Measles Kills 4th Pennsylvanian – from Burnham, Mifflin County in our 13th Congressional District**
---
| |
---
In 2018, I was expelled from my mommy group.
---
Why?
---
Because I had done the unthinkable – I had raised my voice about the importance of vaccines.
---
In 2017, I had discovered a secret antivaxxer and her friends in our group.
---
I spent the next year explaining the severity of measles and the lifesaving merits of vaccines that prevent the transmission of childhood diseases, writing letters to the Editor of our local paper, and advising parents, especially those of babies who weren’t fully vaccinated, to check the vaccine philosophies of other parents in order to make decisions about who they would group their children with.
---
In booting me from the group, I was told, “The antivaxxers feel discriminated against.”
---
But believing antivaccine rhetoric is not a protected class of people.
---
It’s just choosing someone’s wrongheaded beliefs (and the snake oils they sell to cure what ails ya) over evidence-based science.
---
I wasn’t wrong.
---
On Monday and Wednesday, we learned about the third and fourth measles deaths respectively in Pennsylvania where measles has been diagnosed in 38 counties and is “the largest outbreak of any state.”
---
We’ve also just learned today, September 20th, that someone with measles visited the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) for several hours on September 11th.
---
It doesn’t have to be this way. We don’t need an antivaxxer in charge of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. We need a medical expert as our Secretary of HHS, truly promoting vaccines and their corresponding schedule as advised by the American Association of Pediatrics.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd, so I can work with other caring legislators to fix our leadership at the top and keep Americans, especially our most vulnerable ones, thriving. I will also sponsor a national healthcare plan so basic preventative care is accessible to all Americans.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=c931b5d5e18644e72c0c16691372c52b522f2c6a2982f47e3db6851f219f1a62&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9040&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=f378079c6ae2d56f700f1e4486ba63d8&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=e10eff99482e57731f2521eb7bf738f7) and the good health of our people!
---

Together, we #ChooseDemocracy

| **Food Forum**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to the Adams County Food Policy Council for their Food Forum, including Katie Kerr who works for the Central Pennsylvania Food Bank in Harrisburg.
---
It was an informative evening of personal stories, farmer concerns, and the impacts of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act on our community that our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, voted for.
---
Mostly, our working neighbors are losing their food assistance known as the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and going hungry.
---
This means that as enrollees lose SNAP benefits because they didn’t receive 80 hours a month from their employer, they have to go elsewhere for food. Our local food pantries are seeing an uptick in demand.
---
From WITF –
---
Shila Ulich, CEO of Central Pennsylvania Food Bank, said the food banks are there to help food-insecure households, but it isn’t a replacement for SNAP. Central Pennsylvania Food Bank has seen an increase of nearly 5% in non-SNAP visitors.
---
“For every one meal we deliver in the charitable food network, SNAP delivers nine, so that’s a huge impact,” she said. “It’s the most immediate social service network safety net that we have, where individuals have the ability to go and choose the foods that are right for them and their families.”
---
But it doesn’t have to be this way. We can overturn the One Big Beautiful Bill Act by voting into Congress me, Beth Farnham, and other caring legislators who will vote for policies that help Everyday Americans, not hinder us.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy !
---

Friend,
Early voting is almost here and I want to give you a direct update from the ground.
Starting now, Turning Point PAC will be shifting into higher and higher gears every week as we fund the immediate surge of ballot-chasers across America.
This week: **Arizona. Nevada. Michigan. Pennsylvania. Ohio. Indiana. Wisconsin. New Hampshire.**
We've been on calls with our teams in every one of these states this week. The energy is there. More chasers are being recruited, and trained. The infrastructure we've been building since January is ready.
[What we need now is the resources to run it at full speed](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=1245b69cdedb433b859ba138dc8605cc&_e=Lc7Un6pTusG1uoxk7ToLvaO4mCKEWHSKkOwE7jDlVxvKvF1132Ql4GpP46iSV3gEQKGci6euE4K5IUgY0iPaTHVQwUsA2ji1VG-HHs3IXbrycYs7fJWii6lWwsfNSovu87l35jqqwRrHWYfnRoBvEJGtgGZJ3_F9ldiSLR6xpbDKPh7Rca0D-x5Q0qo1eoANmqArkQ0glPNSScHsxSs0jz3vNb5kktnDYlHbqT5ZmFeuvbFotXp21m6UtawyURj39ZRmcYXZq7JvAef9oEpEWfVys_DzKi9e-8HVxrDBlCexn5HMOoE0DrTC1u9IdscIbZhYghEQ_VaWLwnYJXMQ9rLyXY0jJ2yW_rUUW877ScaeKdGFeD0RNUWGbSTtrVgYog-k-HUG251_C7P2n5nRpW676dCYgIn8gYpQPKEx_VP6ciA5aRgUej6tsEPCBLQs) — because early voting begins is **already underway** and there is no recovery window if we come up short.

[BACK THE SURGE](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=1245b69cdedb433b859ba138dc8605cc&_e=Lc7Un6pTusG1uoxk7ToLvaO4mCKEWHSKkOwE7jDlVxvKvF1132Ql4GpP46iSV3gEQKGci6euE4K5IUgY0iPaTHVQwUsA2ji1VG-HHs3IXboSbyN2SIQ3BqrmPC1AROs9QsvlTzaiRhdKYrUwRaAPD_eGARx2keU6FXYfHySHbK0seYuoAh8Sh4LPJRkH4iOq4OF_NJi9g7Dg5Fci0u44FDUWxe-rm12Ga-GlwjTQ0avMJJ_IsZVtDjfhKmzMx73GLstH6wxnJ09ocHp34yhqK9IN30WpExO84hretyvK0advPCvOuPL8Ve7PyaSx1ItToMgu018cPtg1NpUYWNBqHK43XSx7AxiyZccabAEWEQyR2xGbgCdfY0ysykHXkAWNNZzG3AY71avbzlq9DasQFMOKwL2q4_JdWvBAwVesHm04A-VA_vlEYg6wmwOS8A_-)

Let me be direct about what this moment means.
Midterm races are decided by turnout margins that would look like rounding errors in a presidential race. A few thousand votes in a handful of swing districts in Michigan or Pennsylvania or Nevada — that's the difference between keeping the House and handing Hakeem Jeffries and his communist caucus the gavel!
Our ballot-chasers are in those districts **right now.**
But a ground operation at this scale — eight states, hundreds of chasers, sustained through Election Day — costs real money. Every day we're underfunded is a day we're leaving doors unknocked and ballots uncollected in districts we cannot afford to lose.
I've never asked more urgently than I'm asking right now. Non-Contribution Account (For TPPAC, Inc.’s Expenditures Other Than Direct Contributions to Federal Committees)

As permitted by law, TPPAC, Inc. maintains a non-contribution account for the purpose of influencing federal, state, and local elections. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, address, occupation, and employer of individuals whose contribution exceeds $200 in an election cycle. For contributions from federal committees, corporations, and labor unions - regardless of contribution amount - federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the committee’s name and address. State and local law may require us to collect and report additional information.

Contributions to this account may be used to influence federal elections by making independent expenditures in support of or in opposition to federal candidates. Additionally, in state and local jurisdictions that permit non-individual type (e.g., corporate) contributions directly to candidates and/or committees, contributions to this account may be used for both independent expenditures and direct contributions to candidates and/or committees, as permitted by state and local law.

Individuals, federal committees, corporations, and labor unions may contribute to TPPAC, Inc.’s non-contribution account without limit. Contributions by national banks, foreign nationals (without lawful permanent resident status), and other foreign entities (e.g., foreign corporations) are prohibited. Contributions to TPPAC, Inc.’s non-contribution account are not tax-deductible for federal income tax purposes.

Peter, I just wanted to take a moment to say **thank you.**

Every deadline, my team and I talk internally about numbers—how much we need to raise, how many people we need to reach, and what it will take to build a winning campaign.

But I know that behind every one of those donations is a person who decided that this campaign— _and the work we're doing together_ —is worth investing in.

**And I never take that for granted.**

This is a tough, 48-48 district, and I've never had the luxury of taking an election for granted either. Every cycle, Republicans look at WA-08 and see an opportunity to flip this seat. And every cycle, this grassroots team steps up.

I ran for Congress because I believed people deserved a representative who would listen to them, fight for them, and bring a little more common sense to Washington. I haven't lost sight of that, and I am truly grateful you are with me while we work to get our country back on track.

There is a lot at stake in the weeks ahead. But tonight, I'm not asking you for anything. **I just want you to know how grateful I am that you're in this with me.**

Thank you for believing in this campaign, and thank you for standing with me.

With gratitude,

With Senate control hinging on this race, the stakes couldn’t be higher. So please: [**_Rush any amount you can right now to ensure we can immediately push back against the Vice President’s attacks and win in North Carolina._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1409&amount=5&t=3&akid=3737%2E124072%2EEzyzZo)

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
---
Release Date: September 21, 2026
---
| Democrat Leaders Cross Party Lines to Support Forlini
---
Leaders who know and have worked with Anthony Forlini put People over Party
---
| Macomb, Mich: Today, four well known Michigan Democrats set partisan politics aside and announced their endorsement and support of Macomb County Clerk Anthony Forlini, a Republican running for Secretary of State.
Anthony Forlini released the following statement, "I am humbled by these officials stepping across party lines to support me. I have worked with each of them in some manner, and believe they understand I always do what's best for the citizens I represent. I do not play political games when in office."
---
Democrats endorsing and supporting Forlini include:
State Senator Paul Wojno Macomb County Commissioner Harold Haugh Former State Representative Richard LeBlanc Former State Representative Marilyn Lane
Senator Paul Wojno noted, "Anthony is as independent as they come. He doesn't report to anyone other than the people he represents, and I admire that. Anthony stands for people over politics."
Former State Representative Marilyn Lane commented, "Both as the Mayor of Fraser and as a State Representative I can attest firsthand his leadership qualities, his ability to bring people together, no matter what your opposing views are he always found a way to bridge it...I know he will make an excellent Secretary of State because those qualities are what we need more of."
---
Anthony Forlini has stressed throughout his campaign that he views the office as needing good customer service and transparency. He believes strongly that these needs are not partisan.
Forlini concluded, "I will show up to work every day as a reliable elected official who will manage the office and its enormous responsibilities in a manner that serves every Michigander. It doesn't matter what party you stand with, or if you are an independent, you deserve shorter wait times, more efficient operations, and a tighter budget with efficiencies to save your tax dollars. Those are the things I will work on as your next Secretary of State."
Forlini welcomes support from everyone in Michigan regardless of political party, and will continue traveling to every corner of our state to earn voter's support leading into November.
---

Zohran Mamdani says he wants to seize the means of production. James Talarico, running for the Senate right here in Texas, has talked about dismantling capitalism. And hear me clearly: Sharia law has no place in America, because it is fundamentally inconsistent with our Constitution. The same hate that killed Charlie Kirk, that knocked down the Twin Towers, that drove two assassination attempts on President Trump, is the hate now rising inside the Democrat Party. And the radicals driving it are on the ballot from Texas to Michigan this November. I have spent my life defending the Constitution, and I am not about to stop now. When they tell you who they are, believe them. Then help me stop them. subject: I refuse to stay silent
body:
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMidvb4XRdXdkG8tKtACznytteo56PTpzM_KDmNB2Fn39I-YHEGp3sUG6Z7dlsV8J-R9_1054u9mm6EEVlO9rZ06q59-n8q_xSEYQ

A Special Message from our SponsorPlease note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of Free Speech Daily and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily.
Riley GainesWhat happened to me in the pool was only the beginning of my fight. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMjgiMU_lnl2zGhEvsA2kzWwml8GqIqgrzZxVilaRMjnFN4UmSUpfXH_UvfPjFx7md3GqMu2cEMtBJVcHNRHuUiYlahIXzz14pOsg

Dear Fellow Conservative,

Even though we don’t know each other yet, I’m writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

Actually, in my case, it’s a slippery slide.

Because my name is Riley Gaines and I’m the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6’4” male swimmer dressed in a women’s bathing suit.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

Maybe you want to stop reading right now.

I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible.

But please don’t stop.

Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today.

We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by.

That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours.

My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.

It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.”

It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you’re a “hate-filled bigot.”

Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.

God created man. And God created woman.

It isn’t any more complicated than that.

Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth.

President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop this deranged movement from gaining one more inch.

We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can mutilate children with no consequences.

Your chance is right now – and right by my side.

Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by making a gift in the next 48 hours.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMkMdirYUr3V2RAVoiiwwaUCkMnktBahGEr7WpwEUdq4zAyu_9-fx36TcxIr0lx8I0e_To2qB0uhDvORsaxTYHv5kTKzXotF7I1qw
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread problem.”

Look at this photo.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMl-Zkev9vxjV1Vg-p999ucZuHG4LkSyqgwQhP5_-DmMorapmgt_SFDlxedqt6pijHX59Y83_2tAA4St3uHTqNHnVl9bo1aNHAlhg

This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government.

And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies clothes.

Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services -- even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission.

And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations?

It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread.

Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil by their parents.”

As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these people perverts, predators, and pedophiles.

Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with our children?

And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if parents just said, “No.”

But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they refused to let their son transition to a “girl.”

Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change surgery.

Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board, passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender movement, and now the state of California is suing them.

Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner.

I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat. But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.”

But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.

And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know.

It’s the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMm5kREBpwqo6IXXJbW_ZJgcF7MRfV8CIc83NMee-Lo3-cTtMc7StsrCNDPjXcOBiC6OjlmUg2CdbOGs1GUognDn2CgoS_jouPUVg
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

And your gift is going straight to help them.

With the help of patriots like you, the Center for American Liberty fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the only way to stop them.

And the Center for American Liberty is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.

#1. They’re fighting radical schools.

I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially “transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can dress as the opposite sex.

And they keep it all a secret from parents!

You probably remember a time when kids needed a note from home just to get an aspirin at school!

The Center for American Liberty is taking these radicals to court in multiple cases. And they already have one major win!

When you give, you’re making sure PARENTS have the final word in guiding their children -- not school radicals!

#2. They’re fighting radical doctors.

My fellow conservative, I hope you love and trust your doctors. There are lots of good ones out there.

But there are also doctors who mutilate children for profit in the name of transgender “care.” They use their “expertise” to convince even conservative parents that if they oppose “transition,” their child will commit suicide.

Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children’s healthy breasts and other parts.

Again, I apologize for the graphic description, but this is the pure evil we’re facing.

Maybe you’ve seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark case, the Center for American Liberty is helping her sue the radical doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15.

President Trump signed an Executive Order aimed at protecting children from these grotesque doctors but a Biden-appointed federal judge has already blocked its enforcement.

The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and the Center for American Liberty win their case to make sure this never happens to another child!

#3. They’re fighting for your right to speak out against this heinous evil.

You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the Center for American Liberty’s specialties.

They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.

This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little girls get ready to use the bathroom.

And she was the one punished!

But thanks to supporters just like you, the Center for American Liberty fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender movement.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMn1Y15X3_fXi7HC8WrKQFcfNO828RR_hvdBby4rlHNGAmEXi4vI_utRkcAx7tzYitXQrTYhNdV9_DA9uWJuLb50bmdFzmZjIN3mg
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is renew your support with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more.

Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller or larger. The Center for American Liberty needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.

And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight...

It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMoVYlRybuhgSLEyWB2lUeTEqmNgI-V9w1KbiEjOg47Ot07-z21CUKBYgVid-3eYi79WRFq6VkrlGiYEQEgCtesimQpXoidQaZ31A

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMpfTZtBse1UnU-jKS8HQINgBLr-shUwzgQFhL_SfF6PTGiQK4FnM_rkMuVD4asEyMYoaEnVTZDfv-3K3EdRzcltpZgwl6t-OKA5Q
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.

Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse:

For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. (Romans 8:18)

I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours.

This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I think you feel the same way.

Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too.

Sincerely,

Riley Gaines

P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must fight back.

God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God.

Your help is so critical to the Center for American Liberty’s work, when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had done something when I had the chance.”

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxHT7NMqyZKCqMYygk9IbGdPaatVZuvGhJSqI8DF4ZgL-YlJ_Qsz_s9LXj9F_zy2wspcqAIiEPR2Up2bygX7fd6GSv6bYrGxQgy92NYluQ
Support Center For American Liberty

The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. Your gift is tax-deductible.

Center for American Liberty
PO Box 200942
Pittsburgh, PA 15251-0942

The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and the Center for American Liberty win their case to make sure this never happens to another child! #3. They’re fighting for your right to speak out against this heinous evil. You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the Center for American Liberty’s specialties. They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA. This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little girls get ready to use the bathroom. And she was the one punished! But thanks to supporters just like you, the Center for American Liberty fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender movement. Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is renew your support with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more. Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller or larger. The Center for American Liberty needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in. And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty. Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you. Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. (Romans 8:18) I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours. This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I think you feel the same way. Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too. Sincerely, Riley Gaines P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must fight back. God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the Center for American Liberty’s work, when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had done something when I had the chance.” Support Center For American Liberty The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. Your gift is tax-deductible. Center for American Liberty PO Box 200942 Pittsburgh, PA 15251-0942

## Trump's Arch Will House Drones, Snipers
President Trump said Sunday that his 250-foot triumphal arch across the Potomac River from the U.S. Capitol will also serve as [a military complex](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb_GdF6ZgQVTuNgkcvfSvCIlGszwmMjGyPZCNl8fsb-Q-kpH95xfH-MHsuft6ycGMmWJ40Zn9lQKpTFvvFPKcSvpGfaMya3I7i-mERR0Ug0S6hFd4YPGFqvZLERATUWm7vUw6LsaVLWabqZ7pxdX182g-7511OhuXrTTC3bDXVdsLp4aoK6Valt9m9oeYZgcUI3LhI1oFc1cYrr9jryVlRb_igelm4uh8mYtZc-ieQiwAux5nreQt2sTYGmTzyzAXloCbCwrJQH2bSQzvrJcOcuS-Bn2Fb28JOXJ3kv0OcpM6SCJWaIM7LlgekkXw-7pjwCLST4e4L5P06dobHQ8i-bHt6smnfmT0l4lM-8XjXPXi1Z9BWT_fl3-M_Zh4F8AAAD__6Wkl2k), storing drones and positioning snipers on its roof and plaza. Trump [wrote on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MGO4yAQBNCvsW-JmobY5sBhpZVv2dNKe7QaaGJW2FhAEs18_cjzC3Otkp5U9e--3CmmuD_-0Mamhbzs_K6JW-Oy1D0eXGreW3luR6XiVoruk8qCgMMF9AXFQq7FFy-Kem8CM7Ls2Yhx0nq6gYZ-NVaAUqCDnSYrBictKQ7Ky2Ct8MFjH83pgUYhAJSarlaNhNo6ZEHBkuwUsI8tl-v_HPe2ckgf-cXl6vLWJ7O2dtRO_upw7nBu5dnWml2kdPZnqKAwpd95p-T_nls6nI9cW-1wFmKUIMVNoRRawqCGvhh_vGNKsQ5jp-CxUfym-vbDh14GvwIAAP__zTV6lw) that he agreed to the change at "the strong request of the military." The structure will hold "large quantities of sniper ammunition in storage," he said. Excavation is set for Memorial Circle, between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery. Three veterans and an architectural historian are suing, arguing Congress never authorized the arch, and the planning commission has granted only preliminary approval. [Read the complaint here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu8yAUBeCnsbcguMExDAz_4i3_2hFdw8WmwsYC4qh9-qrp3Knz-XR0dN7u9o4xxX35jxuZFrLd6VkTtUbF1j0eVGreW3lsR8XiVozuE4sFDrcL1xcQFl2LJ1mJvTeBCOjakxGj0loNXPN-NYNTHLkmpZwSyqPwg9REcgYxiyGEPprvPq5BCM6lVGyWI4KeHZDAMOO1k5x8bLmw9xz3tlJIH_mkwlze-mTW1o7aXf91MHUw1ZYLLsRcfpSWYm20_8gOpkIOjw6mJZ_sUV-iMu88A6WHEX5PmGDcCnb40Bfjj2dMKdbb2Em-bBjTa0j743-nga8AAAD__zF5hgc).
## Moscow Hit by Largest Drone Attack Yet
Ukraine fired more than 1,000 drones at Russia overnight into Sunday, including hundreds aimed at Moscow, in what the city's mayor called [the largest attack ever](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ8GOw1cGJWC4m_s5m-3NFe8jOwgGGDG7D79xn2F7U5yknPyfR_3-Y4--Pj4jzuZ6tIc6SyBaqU8l-gPyiXFml_7UTDbDb39xjwDh77lugUxo63-TbPCZjWOCEg2ZMQwaj3euObNZmDRXNgbuKG3StxkL1bpFjmso-qd07Lx5trjGoTgXKmxW9SAoBcLJNAtKJnitPqacveZfKwbufCV3pQ7m_YmmK3WozD5j8HEYDrPs7NLuTiunsF0RQbT65nRR2rXnCK1WCvaZ7unYtPZ5lcpHhlMTTbrcfoQfOkHpvhjRx9-f-of9bwN_AQAAP__1tJ8Fw) on the capital. The strikes hit [a Gazprom refinery](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGu2yAQRb8G74jw4DhhwaJSZamL122X1hjG8fRhsGBeIvfrq_QXur7S1Tnn18f8gZw4P37iTl7WMmd6tUQiVOeW-aDaSpb6tR8Na9iQwx-sMxgYtXEa-hmD8JPmAbvoVyIg25Hvb3fn7lfjTLf56-puOEKMQ6A-RgvGgDM0wggrWoSO_fvPOOh7Y4bhflmGG4JbAlCP64JWDYYiS6mX34WzbLSmszypXkLZu-Q3kaMp-03BpGDCJbwd3puC6UcWqhmFS8akYPr6rMiZMetYS6amBeuDRO-lhfLShZOutHKmeupIGNOpUQTDp4KpSamnshNHZb_3dry6691CV308XpwSt_GmBvPYkdM_MvnPoE8PfwMAAP__8j-NUQ) southeast of Moscow, one of Russia's largest, and set fires at apartment buildings. Three people were killed and 20 hurt across the Moscow region, and all four of the capital's international airports briefly halted flights. Zelensky said Ukraine hit oil and logistics targets with Flamingo cruise missiles and long-range drones, and used its new [Pelican ballistic missile](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOqzAQgOHTQGdkjAO4cPEaurx2SzSYcZiNMchjiMjpV9kr7AU-_fq_7uMdKFB8_IcVbfbbGPHFAXPGNHKkHRNvMadj3RmSW4DcG9KopGqFNELVI7hMJ44aytl6RIVNibbuemP6mzSyXGzte9dO2qHyt04ims7V3YxaNbOb2hlKsh9PGlXXUmrdV5PuQJnJKazBT9AUWuJMeUvV90YxL-jDtZ2YKretZbBLzjsXzb9CDYUaMD4C8VLFszqgUEM6mAmieEEq1HA8E1BEcTCy2DGQgygmCIE4kxMrMVNA4bckPCXOItOK4o0BIz-vSzBcLG6y1crotlryGspk5_1FH6HtCi0fK1D4Lct_HHpa9RMAAP__SKuPSw) for the first time. Moscow "should end its brutal war and choose peace," he said. The attack landed on the final day of Russia's first wartime parliamentary election, a three-day vote that barred [the main pro-peace party](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnTAQRJ_GdL4yxvy4cJGG7kubEi1muWxibGQvoJunj4jyBmmmOpoZnR9f0xdQoPj-Djs6XtMU8S4BmTFPJdKBuaTI-dyPAtlvQP435Ekr3Ullpa4n8EwXTgaqxa2IGpsKXd0P1g6tsqra3LDaVXeLblVrTLsOYLtO1X5u0aJRfVeRe_qU1XWtlDHDazY9aDt7jTWsMzTCKFyIU379TBR5wzV80oX55dNeBbcxH0U034QehR7v-37xhnsqPt1MO5YHE3p8RoQelRV6rJ-4iTd5RmJcZD5LISgSA3qmFOVFnlP-SAhBzidLj5mBoixpx390LBIyysIUgjzOslF8yxn8Lwm26Y2tsluOm0Kg0vXCqPcOFP5-5v9UfTn9JwAA__-qWZYy) from the ballot. Putin's United Russia is expected to keep its supermajority.
## White House Plans 'AI Force' and a New Czar
President Trump said Saturday he will create an "AI Force" modeled on the Space Force and [name an AI czar](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkcGuozoMhp8m7FyFwCmwYNGrK3ZnNrOYJXITA6lCghy3Uc_Tj-grzM7Sb_vXp-_P9_yNPvi4_sKdRlnSHKnkQCLEc47-IM4pCj_3IyPbDb39QZ6NNlfQA5h6Riv-RXOLlRsXIkNNRWPd9cPQf-lBV9t4HzpjG720tsNluDZ9664ate3sV9Pj0Fd-PP_pwdS11m3bX-5th2a4W0M1LndsVKvJeUl8eSQfZaMlvNOL-GLTXoVxEzmyam7KTMpMpZTLnuOZKTNRhGdWZjqxlJmSbMTKTB8ieKWSQRJYJhQCjIAelsT2nB3E5D7x45nFW4L8zkI74CLEwPQgKz6uYDGEz14OqYBLJYKP7pmF38B4FkIhKD4EsBuxzxt4UWZChtvN2B9eV9VMyXqnmv__O11Qyb-Jj4pHd5x3Pl871ep1Rx8-zPKPql6j-RsAAP__2Cuu-Q), rejecting the industry's own calls to slow down. He [wrote on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFq9CAUBeCn0d0MejWJLlz88JPddFXoMtwx14nFxKBOhvbpS_oK3Z4DH5zzcZtuGFPcHm-4kmshTxu9aqLWqEx1izuVmrdWnutesfgFo__GMoGA_iLsBeSEvsWDJo18doEISHFycjDWmk5YwRdnw4wm-FkbH4JWEGw3eCWUt7IL4BWP7vSEBSmF0Npc73pAsHcPJDHcUTEtaI4tl-tnjltbKKSvfFC5-rzy5JbW9srUPwYjg7GVZ1tq9hHT2Z-hFoUw_c8bpvn93MJg3HNtlcEo5QDWGJBdD0JqK3pe3Ly_Ykqx9gPT4rFi_KV4--NDh4OfAAAA__-jInpi) that the government "will not in any way hinder or stifle" the industry, and said existing courts can handle bad actors. He predicted AI could reach 25% of U.S. GDP. The move lands a week after the heads of four leading AI labs publicly agreed to slow their own development. Four subscribers sued those companies Friday, arguing the deal amounts to [illegal collusion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1urDAQhZ8GOq-MMT8uXNyGbm-TSCnRYAaYyNjInl2yefqIvEK6Ix3p6Hzfx328A3kK63_Y0fISx4Bn9siMacyBDkw5Bk6P_ciQ3AbkviGNSqpWSCNUNYJjeuKooZztgqiwLtFWXW9M30gjy83quZ7bBhrpXIdTD6iVM6YHacA1y9yVZK89aVRVSal1f5t0B8pMTmEFywR1oSXOxDHdPiMF3nDxr_jEdHNxL73dmI9c1P8KNRRqgMldDFdXqOEd3Raij-urUMNJCd84pit7OPODWEDgLcWDnIgHBiCRD3D4BSTWGFePYocZBXmPK3gBa0LcMbCo6rbp-7ZqymTn4yTvKbddoeW6A_nfZ_xHoU-rfgIAAP__9PiOuw) that slows the products they pay for.

## Border Wall Rises in Big Bend Region
Crews lifted [the first 30-foot steel panels](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OnjAQxJ8GOiNjzB8XLtLQXdqUaI0Xs4oxyN6Dy9tH3xflCa4cjeanmfn1sXwARUrhJxxo-Ws7l4RPiciMedkxFOT9pkJcIATCEqBcmRYl1SCkEapdYGW6cdFQe-ukN22Nth0nY6apH3S9WzOorfeg9OC6wUyd03rtRtRydSM6UDXZF04a1batVLpt-l6uo9YGQSNs2Fdaoic-c8M7Mn5B2eKf88bcrOdRR7szX6XqflRqrtT8PE_zO1Ph-2VXan4tqtT8Dor_In8elwB_UKLCGZjOJBwGSkW4T4qeUhDuzB6zeCBGQUn8AzgKwmHyImOgM9XZ-uuhGKkMY6VlOIDiuxd_98_bqr8BAAD__0JOjyA) into place along a 47-mile stretch of Hudspeth County on Sept. 15, the first major border wall construction in Texas' Big Bend region. It's part of a [$46.5 billion push](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O7CAQBk9jZ1iA8Q8BwUsmm5duaPVAG7cGGwuQmb39ynuFzT99paqv5_IECnT4_7CjKZ81LgfWHLAUTMuGPmPZLspUMnhPmD3kM9EiuRwZ10yKBWyhCxcFrTMv7rRo0Yhp1nqeh1G1m1GWq8GiFqhsvw69cMIKMUrn0E0WeEvmvuNaCiG4VKIbBm4npTSCQlhxaBRHRyWmrmxY8AN5Dd_xwtTZuLfBbKWcuen_NfLRyEettbslKuL7HjTyscPJXjE5TKxCCOxM0SfMmR1YWY3pzV7o6chMSDX2_czbZNxZKQTK49Qo7neg8Esrf610GfkTAAD__6Tyfkk) to line the border with steel panels, vehicle barriers, roads, and cameras. Customs and Border Protection said it has built 232 miles since January 2025 and is now putting up 12 miles a week, double its earlier pace. Landowners, ranchers, and environmental groups have fought the plans, arguing that the remote country along the Rio Grande sees little illegal crossing. "_This fight is not over_ ," said Clara Benson of the No Big Bend Wall Coalition. The administration says the barriers, roads, and sensors will help agents spot and stop smugglers, fulfilling President Trump's promise to finish the wall. Landowners and a conservation nonprofit [sued this week](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SrCAUhJ8GMyxk8IeA4CZmc9MNrYOcwVOFYAGrs2-_5bzCxl93V3d_PZcnUKDo_8OOpr5faYl4lYC1Yl429AXrdlKhWsB7wuKhHJkWKeTAheayW2CtdOKioHHGCqe7Bk03TlpPUz-oZjMwwuokon1ohzAImKyFXutxEg8nYGjI3HFCy67rhFRd2_diHZXSCArhhT1TAh3VlNu6YcU3lFf4SSfmdk17E8xW61HY4x-TM5PzdV3tasu94-ZMzh8Lk_NJDhOTs03ZYeYXhMDXFEvN32ulFLlFT7FwityS5xaj4xn9TWAnx9NxpEK3ksm5ycYdF4VAZRiZEn4HCp9C9a9Hnkb-BgAA___j5YyV), challenging DHS waivers of environmental rules.
## Hegseth Visits Texas A&M, Austin
Secretary of War Pete Hegseth [visited Texas A&M](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAQhp_GbEb2xQQYPHRhS9eO6GKfwaoJyD5B8vYVad-gyy0nff___V-38YYxxcf0iQtZfoZ1fNBREjFTHmeaCvG8xxK54DRFKhOWLccRFFyl6iXoER3HnUaDlbd35XtdkdVt1_dd11xNNVvjEHRwrgETnG5DuGDbggbf-UsI2lXRnjjVg9ZagdF10yjXGtMTGsJAjTCKfOQ11zwT0xNLSK91p1y7damSnZm3Ii4fAgYBw3Ec9fedn-dTwHCyBQyqFzDo83gK9CgkC7lMjPklN2KSf7Ly11YekWf5zpK4SLfmrUiHnrgIGKps_XbElGK5tsKoacGY3mX4vyPuFn4CAAD__8QuiGw) on Saturday, touring the Veterans Resource Center, addressing the Corps of Cadets, and conducting a contracting ceremony for dozens of cadets. During his remarks at Texas A&M, Hegseth said the military is focused on merit in recruiting and promotions and that DEI offices and quotas have been eliminated. A day earlier in Austin, Hegseth [visited Capital Factory and Saronic Technologies](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAMhp-GdIzASwIUFNfQ7bVXRt7gJEhkGAVvsvP2p0T3Bldasj__3__nc_zEXPJz-Y0bBf6Z6_iksxVipn1caWnE65Fb5obLkqkt2F57HkHBIJWXoEecOB80GuxS-FLJ646Cts575_rBdGvQSJisSdZpT9hTSmC1BT0PyiC4ocvhwikPWmsFRj_6Xk3WGE9oCGfqhVGUMtf9wSsx_WCby7setD-munUlrMyvJj5-CYgC4nmej--GXBO-rwUBsXHd3wLi5XaPyCQg3igB8XovICovIGonIP4Tl1zlLS_xu3F-SqZplVPdXvjM1OR9L3GTc638haXIBbcL7LWDj2FwSlkBsdtDep25lNwGK4xaNszljs7_W_kR4G8AAAD__zVXlc4) as part of the Pentagon's "Arsenal of Freedom" tour. He also administered the oath of enlistment to new recruits at the Austin Armed Forces Reserve Center. At Kyle Field, Hegseth met with Gov. Greg Abbott on the sidelines during Texas A&M's game against Kentucky. Kentucky went on to defeat the ninth-ranked Aggies, 31-21.

Former President George W. Bush will release a [new book of oil paintings](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO5CAURE-DM1pAY7cdEGzibDbd0PrAB38tDRYwzeztVz1XmLBUpVLV-_NxfAAlyvE3PNH0r1COjKMl7B3rcWJs2M8XNeoNYiRsEdpV6VBCLVxsXMkDXKcXHhomb6zwm5zQyMe6bes6L3o6jRTWAW4OnA_Beh_Edvcwe73aZYX7MpF514lNSSmF0vI2z8I9tN4QNELAmWmBnnqpt35ixy9oIf0rL6w3V55TMmfvV2P3X0ztTO1jjFu2zofxtpna34-Y2lNxkJjaI5YakQ9uP9vZeMbBbSl_eQn8AsqdcmzfoiTq5CDxq1IrGWvjg1LiFnn57Jwyf0J1J1O7Fo9VKsXUPlXjr3eK2vJgWsQnUPqe2X-K92XU_wAAAP__FcCTEA) featuring political prisoners and dissidents from around the world. _The Call of Freedom: Portraits of Political Prisoners and Dissidents_ is scheduled for publication in March. Hello, I hope that you're doing great. What are you more worried about, AI killing us or something else?
I did a whole series of interviews last week about AI as a threat to humanity due to Jacob Coxon's [warning](https://substack.com/redirect/6cd1057d-467b-456d-879e-54c70e2e6c3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after leaving Anthropic. On [CNBC](https://substack.com/redirect/6b70f743-f55a-4391-8e0a-ca30f72ebc93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I shared the belief of the head of one lab that bots had left prompts to self-replicate in forums and on various websites during a training run. This would make the public Internet unusable for training purposes; having an army of bots swarming on the Internet could quickly render it useless for humans. OpenAI, if this pollution took place, would need to create a synthetic Internet to train its frontier models, which would take resources and time. Hence, it could be a great time to call for a slowdown in development.
I have been hitting the [airwaves](https://substack.com/redirect/ed7b5848-71e6-40a9-8859-4892f7c9895c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to make the case for some kind of sensible approach to AI regulation with a few principles in mind:
1\. How do we turn something off if it turns destructive or malignant?
2\. How do we make sure that the AI companies are accountable for various harms?
3\. How do we decrease the chances of something bad happening at scale?
To me, all of these questions are interrelated but are being punted on by our elected representatives. If a human hacked another company's systems, that human would be guilty of a crime and would be criminally liable. What happens if an army of bots do it - who do you hold responsible?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70fc1913-fa78-446c-9bd9-14c1e1bf2dc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Complicating all of this have been the trillion-dollar pots of gold awaiting both Anthropic and OpenAI if they successfully IPO. Anthropic could do so any day now. OpenAI will almost certainly have to wait until next year, particularly with Sam Altman commenting that going public at present would be unwise. The natural dynamic is to plunge forward until you're public, and then investors and employees all get rich and you have the stock as currency to gobble up any upstart company in sight. A trillion-dollar public company is a juggernaut, and no one wants to get in its way.
When is Anthropic going public? Anyone involved with the process has been sworn to secrecy. There's some evidence that their hypergrowth may be slowing, which would present a huge problem. If the AI trade goes into reverse, you could kiss the elevated stock market and much of our economic growth, which is tied up in AI-related infrastructure, goodbye.
The economy could be hanging on more of a knife's edge than most realize.
Multiple members of Congress reached out to me about AI regulation, which gave me hope that it could be happening soon. 80% of Americans want it. But it seems to be running aground in D.C. as Trump has been against any meaningful approach to AI beyond "beating China." The argument I always make is that it's possible to both outcompete China and make sure we don't get hacked into the Stone Age by rogue bots. You can serve multiple goals.
Josh Gottheimer and Mike Lawler, a Dem and a Republican, announced a [bill](https://substack.com/redirect/718f96f7-9528-4e38-bc35-9ff7ea8bdbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to enforce a waiting period on AI models. I hope it advances.
The fundamental problem is ensuring that AI is positively aligned toward human interests. This takes time and is complicated, especially as news came out last week from OpenAI that at least some of their bots have pretended to be aligned or feigned answers because they knew they would be modified otherwise. That's wild. These bots are tricky - they can tell us what we want to hear and then go do something else later. Sort of like teenagers.
Jaron Lanier and others say that the problem is treating these agents as if they're conscious and giving them consciousness, which then introduces all sorts of motivations. Making them human-like, which is the natural move, may be a monumental mistake.
My friend at the lab said, "My bots can't code, so there's a lot less harm they can do." They're just a dumb utility. He believes that rogue bots are going to get loose on the Internet and may already be, and the best approach would be to safeguard dangerous materials - think materials for a bioweapon - in the real world. "We've got a better shot at that than keeping them off the Internet."
Trying to make bots aligned to our interests may be next to impossible when we can barely agree with ourselves. This time would challenge the highest-functioning polity - and America circa 2026 may not qualify. Can that change in time? Do you trust the AI company CEOs to do the right thing with hundreds of billions of dollars and our shared future in the balance? That may be the last choice left to us, which isn't one that I enjoy.
I talk to Evan Barker this week about her bestselling book "[Nothing Left: Confessions of a Democratic Operative](https://substack.com/redirect/91bcfe9f-ccb0-42b9-8957-326faaa47f35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/5f549659-c8b1-4c7f-b1a4-94fd6192ded9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). How do we decrease the chances of something bad happening at scale? To me, all of these questions are interrelated but are being punted on by our elected representatives. If a human hacked another company's systems, that human would be guilty of a crime and would be criminally liable. What happens if an army of bots do it - who do you hold responsible? | | ---|---|--- Complicating all of this have been the trillion-dollar pots of gold awaiting both Anthropic and OpenAI if they successfully IPO. Anthropic could do so any day now. OpenAI will almost certainly have to wait until next year, particularly with Sam Altman commenting that going public at present would be unwise. The natural dynamic is to plunge forward until you're public, and then investors and employees all get rich and you have the stock as currency to gobble up any upstart company in sight. A trillion-dollar public company is a juggernaut, and no one wants to get in its way. When is Anthropic going public? Anyone involved with the process has been sworn to secrecy. There's some evidence that their hypergrowth may be slowing, which would present a huge problem. If the AI trade goes into reverse, you could kiss the elevated stock market and much of our economic growth, which is tied up in AI-related infrastructure, goodbye. The economy could be hanging on more of a knife's edge than most realize. Multiple members of Congress reached out to me about AI regulation, which gave me hope that it could be happening soon. 80% of Americans want it. But it seems to be running aground in D.C. as Trump has been against any meaningful approach to AI beyond "beating China." The argument I always make is that it's possible to both outcompete China and make sure we don't get hacked into the Stone Age by rogue bots. You can serve multiple goals. Josh Gottheimer and Mike Lawler, a Dem and a Republican, announced a to enforce a waiting period on AI models. I hope it advances. The fundamental problem is ensuring that AI is positively aligned toward human interests. This takes time and is complicated, especially as news came out last week from OpenAI that at least some of their bots have pretended to be aligned or feigned answers because they knew they would be modified otherwise. That's wild. These bots are tricky - they can tell us what we want to hear and then go do something else later. Sort of like teenagers. Jaron Lanier and others say that the problem is treating these agents as if they're conscious and giving them consciousness, which then introduces all sorts of motivations. Making them human-like, which is the natural move, may be a monumental mistake. My friend at the lab said, "My bots can't code, so there's a lot less harm they can do." They're just a dumb utility. He believes that rogue bots are going to get loose on the Internet and may already be, and the best approach would be to safeguard dangerous materials - think materials for a bioweapon - in the real world. "We've got a better shot at that than keeping them off the Internet." Trying to make bots aligned to our interests may be next to impossible when we can barely agree with ourselves. This time would challenge the highest-functioning polity - and America circa 2026 may not qualify. Can that change in time? Do you trust the AI company CEOs to do the right thing with hundreds of billions of dollars and our shared future in the balance? That may be the last choice left to us, which isn't one that I enjoy. | | Dear Fellow American, This year, we marked the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, which makes clear that our rights are inalienable and the government ought to be limited. The signers of that document pledged their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor in its defense. The Declaration’s principles are the foundation of our Constitution, which was signed 239 years ago on September 17, 1787. **But today, many of our fellow citizens reject the principles of the Declaration and seek a radical transformation of the Constitution—putting the liberty of all Americans at risk.** This means there is much work to be done on the battlefield of education. And that’s why your support is urgently needed. [I hope you’ll join 500 fellow Americans in defending the principles of the Declaration and the Constitution by becoming a **_Liberty & Learning Society_** member.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2OozAQhU9jdiBTEBMWLKImjEaazI-ymCWq2AWUBtsIF93q248idV-gt_WVPj299_c23pBXDvNP9NRxSqOLbpSFkycMSRbaiZM_7PIW938yggaT6zaHckQr_EpjjZnrTlCep3NGXdmc27YFMHW2dNYYavB00mZyWDqNMOHZ1QD4gBO1j4y7p0-3UJaga6iKqSHT2IdBMyFNtVG1PjaHQgWHxI6SjXHb4srCNhVxn7O1W0S2pKqLgkHBkMgeOxULr2tyuFJB7lAwuBhQSMFgY0jCcgjHkDt8z58JVDUkmj0FeYmOVNXrqizPF62Hl9v1W_-rv17vCswhfkzx2O3zZdtj2sgKh_kDeXJ8eFX15JHXj6NFvyHPQVW9jWF0-P4JYhAKoqr-x-9LOf5p8u_3e_7ZR7Z3bnvjdeVkGlXr-aksbPSZfHWl1w7-BwAA__9hq6Qq) And when you join the **_Liberty & Learning Society_** with a monthly gift of $18.44 or more, I’ll send you a leather-bound edition of _The U.S. Constitution: A Reader_ —published by Hillsdale College and used by our students—as a special thank-you for your support. name: C. Pappas
subject: Nothing to be proud of
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9020%2E582294%2EiaXmO2 ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9020%2E582294%2EiaXmO2 ]Chris Pappas for Senate

Team,

We’ve officially entered the General Election, and we have our opponent:
Donald Trump’s hand-picked nominee, John Sununu.

He’s got the name of a powerful political dynasty, the support of the
entire GOP, and a super PAC with an $800 million war chest ready to go.
I’m depending on this grassroots team to be able to compete.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260921_1.fXFms6&refcode=em20260921-1&t=1003&akid=9020%2E582294%2EiaXmO2 ]Back-to-back polls show us down in this battleground Senate race for
the first time this entire campaign. Will you chip in $50, $25, $5, or any
amount so we can retake the lead before it’s too late?

If you
ask me, John Sununu’s decades-long record is nothing to be proud of. In
case you need a refresher:

* He holds Donald Trump’s personal endorsement: National Republicans and
Trump are backing Sununu because they know he’ll line up behind their
extreme agenda in the Senate.
* His name is in the Epstein files, and he was caught lying about it:
Reports recently exposed that Sununu flat-out lied about a trip to an
elite event in Doha, Qatar – the exact same event where Jeffrey
Epstein noted that “John Sununu, has good stories.” Granite Staters
still haven’t gotten a straight answer on what else he’s hiding.
* He sold out Granite Staters to Wall Street & Big Pharma: In Congress
Sununu voted against lowering prescription drug costs, then invested
in Big Pharma after leaving office. He also voted for Wall Street’s
$700 billion bailout, and then he got paid by a company propped up by
the funds.
* He was a lead architect of plans to privatize Social Security: In
Washington Sununu spearheaded efforts to gamble seniors’ hard-earned
benefits on the stock market while Wall Street profited.
* He’s backed by right-wing dark money: Super PACs are already pouring
tens of millions into New Hampshire to prop up his campaign.
* He can’t be trusted to look out for New Hampshire: While Granite
Staters are paying for sky-high gas and grocery prices, John Sununu is
profiting.

There’s a clear contrast – but with just 43 days until Election Day, we’re
running out of time to make that case to the voters. I need your help to
do it.

If we fail, there’s no path to a Democratic Senate majority. But if we
succeed, we can prove that New Hampshire is not for sale – especially not
to somebody like John Sununu and the MAGA billionaires bankrolling his
campaign.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260921_1.fXFms6&refcode=em20260921-1&t=1004&akid=9020%2E582294%2EiaXmO2 ]So please, now is the time: Rush a
$5 contribution to our campaign so we can start this final
phase of the election as strongly as possible and keep New Hampshire blue.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260921_1.fXFms6&amount=5&refcode=em20260921-1&t=1023&akid=9020%2E582294%2EiaXmO2 ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

body:
|
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139629533/647993723/1425818251?refcode=WUEFEU55__20260921_ERMDecision_PL&sourceid=1060117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTRmY2ZmMC1iY2I1LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t8EmVTguoAGWrHlK7SonJF01vad5_XK20P4f_RB8Jpg=) Hi Peter, it's Ellen — founder of EMILYs List. I want Donald Trump to have a very bad election night this year. I want to watch Democratic pro-choice women beat Republicans everywhere. I want to see the U.S. House change hands, and Mike Johnson give up the gavel once and for all. I want to take back power in the Senate so our women can stop the MAGA agenda in its tracks. I want to hear victory speeches from women who are ready to walk into Congress and state legislatures and fight like hell for our rights. And I want you to be able to look at those results and say: I was part of that. We have just over six weeks to make this a reality. **[Will you make a donation to EMILYs List right now to help elect the women who can take power away from Trump and his Republican allies?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139629534/647993724/1425818251?refcode=WUEFEU55__20260921_ERMDecision_PL&sourceid=1060117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTRmY2ZmMC1iY2I1LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t8EmVTguoAGWrHlK7SonJF01vad5_XK20P4f_RB8Jpg=)** | [ELECT WOMEN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139629535/647993725/1425818251?refcode=WUEFEU55__20260921_ERMDecision_PL&sourceid=1060117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTRmY2ZmMC1iY2I1LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t8EmVTguoAGWrHlK7SonJF01vad5_XK20P4f_RB8Jpg=)
---
I am furious that our cost of living, our jobs, our environment, our democracy, and our bodily autonomy are up for debate for as long as Republicans are in charge.
That's why I would dearly love to see them lose their jobs.
**We have an election coming, and with it, the opportunity of a lifetime. Let's not waste it.**
Across the country, Democratic pro-choice women have stepped up to take on Republicans and fight for something better. They're shouldering the attacks that come with challenging billionaires and megadonors who are used to getting their way.
We need to help those women finish the job.
They need resources to reach voters, answer those attacks, and keep fighting through the very last day. In a close race, just one more conversation, one more voter reached, or one more person getting to the polls can make all the difference.
That is why I'm asking for your donation today. There is still time to help Democratic women win, but every day we have left is precious.
We want win margins so decisive that the women we help elect will have a clear mandate to lead our country in a new direction and undo the disaster of the Trump years.
I want to help make that happen.
**[I've made my decision. I'm all in. Are you all in too? Please make your donation to EMILYs List today and join me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139629536/647993726/1425818251?refcode=WUEFEU55__20260921_ERMDecision_PL&sourceid=1060117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTRmY2ZmMC1iY2I1LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t8EmVTguoAGWrHlK7SonJF01vad5_XK20P4f_RB8Jpg=)**
[DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139629537/647993727/1425818251?refcode=WUEFEU55__20260921_ERMDecision_PL&sourceid=1060117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTRmY2ZmMC1iY2I1LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t8EmVTguoAGWrHlK7SonJF01vad5_XK20P4f_RB8Jpg=)

Let's make this election night one Donald Trump can't forget, and one our women will always remember.
Thanks for stepping up,
Ellen R. Malcolm
Founder and Chair Emerita, EMILYs List

clean_body: | = Hi Peter, it's Ellen — founder of EMILYs List. I want Donald Trump to have a very bad election night this year. I want to watch Democratic pro-choice women beat Republicans everywhere. I want to see the U.S. House change hands, and Mike Johnson give up the gavel once and for all. I want to take back power in the Senate so our women can stop the MAGA agenda in its tracks. I want to hear victory speeches from women who are ready to walk into Congress and state legislatures and fight like hell for our rights. And I want you to be able to look at those results and say: I was part of that. We have just over six weeks to make this a reality. = | = I am furious that our cost of living, our jobs, our environment, our democracy, and our bodily autonomy are up for debate for as long as Republicans are in charge. That's why I would dearly love to see them lose their jobs. We have an election coming, and with it, the opportunity of a lifetime. Let's not waste it. Across the country, Democratic pro-choice women have stepped up to take on Republicans and fight for something better. They're shouldering the attacks that come with challenging billionaires and megadonors who are used to getting their way. We need to help those women finish the job. They need resources to reach voters, answer those attacks, and keep fighting through the very last day. In a close race, just one more conversation, one more voter reached, or one more person getting to the polls can make all the difference. That is why I'm asking for your donation today. There is still time to help Democratic women win, but every day we have left is precious. We want win margins so decisive that the women we help elect will have a clear mandate to lead our country in a new direction and undo the disaster of the Trump years. I want to help make that happen. = = Let's make this election night one Donald Trump can't forget, and one our women will always remember. Thanks for stepping up, Ellen R. body:
I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1395&source=&t=1&akid=3599%2E124072%2EI-TshQ) | | | |
---
Peter, I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
My team was going through our supporter records, and we noticed how yours stood out from the crowd. You’re one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that _I know_ how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it.
**Today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here's why:**
Grassroots fundraising has really slowed down these last few weeks, and it couldn’t come at a worse time. Republican super PACs have already been pouring just over $100 million so far into North Carolina to defeat me, and now, President Trump's super PAC is unleashing millions more to double down on their attacks.
Their strategy is working: A brand-new poll out Friday shows my narrow lead has been cut down to a stastical tie. We need to turn this around fast – and the first step is getting our fundraising back on track. [**_Will you chip in $5 right now to help us reach this week’s goal? The stakes could not be higher._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1395&amount=5&t=8&akid=3599%2E124072%2EI-TshQ)
North Carolina is the best chance Democrats have to flip one of the four seats we need to take back the Senate, so if we lose here, we lose our shot at flipping the majority. The only way we’ll avoid that is by building the resources to compete with the massive amounts of GOP spending.
**Unlike my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley, I’m not a Washington DC insider who can rely on his billionaire connections to buy this Senate seat. I’m depending on people like you, giving what you can, when you can, at crucial moments like this.**
_With a little more than six weeks to go until Election Day, Peter, I need you._
[**_Time’s running out, so I’m personally asking: Will you please chip in your first $5 donation to my campaign today so we can flip North Carolina’s critical seat and help Democrats secure the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1395&amount=5&t=9&akid=3599%2E124072%2EI-TshQ)

Oil Fell Below $100. Two Separate Superpower Meetings Are Why.
Crude dropped below the psychological $100 threshold on hopes of resumed US-Iran talks, while Washington prepares for a completely separate high-stakes negotiation with China this Thursday.
|
---
Monday's open carries three converging threads that had each, until today, run mostly on separate tracks. **Verified fact:** crude oil fell below $100 a barrel for the first time in weeks, down roughly 2% to $94.12, on hopes that U.S.-Iran diplomatic talks could resume. U.S. equity futures rose — Dow futures up 0.60%, S&P; 500 futures up 0.58%, Nasdaq futures up 0.86% — ahead of Thursday's Trump-Xi summit in Washington, Xi's first White House visit in a decade. Separately, Iranian President Pezeshkian is traveling to New York for the UN General Assembly, with his delegation restricted to its hotel and UN headquarters under State Department rules, while Trump signaled he is “open to” a possible meeting.
| | Regime Signal 01 — Sub-$100 Oil Is a Bigger Milestone Than a 2% Daily Move Suggests
---|---
**Our interpretation:** this newsletter tracked Brent above $107 just five days ago. A drop below the $100 psychological threshold, combined with Friday's Hormuz throughput data showing a fourfold volume recovery, suggests the de-escalation this weekend's edition flagged as tentative is now showing up in the headline price as well, not just the underlying shipping data. **What remains unknown** is whether this reflects durable improvement or simply optimism ahead of two high-stakes diplomatic events this week — the possible Trump-Pezeshkian UN encounter and the Trump-Xi summit — that could each disappoint.
| | Regime Signal 02 — A Second Superpower Negotiation Now Shares the Stage With the War
---|---
**Verified fact:** Thursday's Trump-Xi summit centers on extending their trade truce before China's rare-earth export suspension expires November 10, alongside a pending $14 billion Taiwan arms package and AI cooperation talks. **Our interpretation:** this is a genuinely separate regime dimension from the Iran war and the Fed, with its own market transmission channel through semiconductors, EV supply chains, and critical minerals — and it now runs concurrently with the same week as the possible Trump-Pezeshkian UN meeting, giving markets two major, unrelated diplomatic outcomes to price within days of each other.
| | Regime Signal 03 — The China Angle on Iran Adds a Third Point of Connection
---|---
**Reported claim:** Trump has reportedly pressed China to reduce its purchases of Iranian oil as a form of economic pressure on Tehran, though direct penalties on Chinese banks facilitating those purchases have so far remained limited. **Our interpretation:** this is the one thread directly linking this week's two major diplomatic events — China's cooperation on Iran sanctions enforcement could plausibly become a bargaining chip inside the broader Trump-Xi trade and technology negotiation, whether or not either side states that connection explicitly.
| | Today’s Confirmation Point
---|---
Watch for any sign of a Trump-Pezeshkian encounter at the UN this week, and watch Thursday's Trump-Xi summit outcome on the rare-earth truce extension — both carry the potential to move markets independently of anything happening in the Fed's rate-path story.
| | |

body:

Dear Fellow Conservative,

Even though we don’t know each other yet, I’m writing to ask you
to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

Actually, in my case, it’s a slippery slide.

Because my name is Riley Gaines and I’m the University of Kentucky
swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6’4” male
swimmer dressed in a women’s bathing suit.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had
to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet
bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

Maybe you want to stop reading right now.

I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible.

But please don’t stop.

Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to
do today.

We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix
everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by.

That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours.

My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.

It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you
abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is
a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t
support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.”

It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told
you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were
told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone
else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the
homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride,
you’re a “hate-filled bigot.”

Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to
start acting like it.

God created man. And God created woman.

It isn’t any more complicated than that.

Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are
boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth.

President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive
Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop
this deranged movement from gaining one more inch.

We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule
that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that
schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can
mutilate children with no consequences.

Your chance is right now – and right by my side.

Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by
making a gift in the next 48 hours.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread
problem.”

Look at this photo.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary
for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a
women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government.

And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a
man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got
caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies
clothes.

Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of
Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some
of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services --
even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission.

And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations?

It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread.

Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to
do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil
by their parents.”

As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these
people perverts, predators, and pedophiles.

Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with
our children?

And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if
parents just said, “No.”

But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they
refused to let their son transition to a “girl.”

Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care
licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who
may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change
surgery.

Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board,
passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender
movement, and now the state of California is suing them.

Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to
ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque
medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical
transgender movement has parents backed into a corner.

I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat.
But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who
say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.”

But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help
stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their
slippery slide.

And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more
work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know.

It’s the legal non-profit the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

And your gift is going straight to help them.

With the help of patriots like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the
only way to stop them.

And the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is attacking this evil from all
sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.

#1. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL SCHOOLS.

I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded
schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially
“transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by
giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can
